WOLF.thesis: Wolfspeed — post-Ch11 SiC; 800V datacenter call-option but negative GM + restructuring overhang.
WOLF.debate_excerpt: Bull: The balance sheet is fixed — Chapter 11 cut total debt ~70%, interest expense ~60%, pushed first maturity to 2030, and left ~$1.2B liquidity, removing the going-concern overhang that defined the 2024–25 story (10-Q, 2026-05-07; Q2/Q3 FY26 calls). On a clean basis it is a vertically integrated, US-made, pure-play SiC franchise with the only fully-ramped 200mm device fab (Mohawk Valley) and a 10kV MOSFET / 300mm crystal tech edge. The call option is 800V AI-datacenter power: datacenter rev +50% then +30% QoQ, customers migrating 400V→800V, and JPM names WOLF among best-positioned 800V beneficiaries ("Watts Up!" 800V AI-DC stack, JPM/Samik Chatterjee, briefing 2026-06-09). JPM's June sector primer adds specifics: WOLF holds the highest-voltage SiC offering in the group (2.3–6.5kV), squarely targeting solid-state transformers (SST) plus 1.2kV SiC for PSUs; it demonstrated 300mm SiC in Jan-2026 (a cost/packaging edge for next-gen AI/HPC), and its fastest-ramping AI revenue is in PSU applications, though management still frames a long-term mix of ~70% EV / ~30% Industrial & Energy (incl.
